name: Ethnicity, Race, and Migration
about: The program in Ethnicity, Race, and Migration (ER&M) provides an interdisciplinary framework for the study of race, ethnicity, and migration. Drawing on the social sciences, humanities, and arts, the program examines the ways in which ethnicity and race are socially constructed, historically contingent, and continually being made and remade through cultural practices, political processes, and everyday interactions. Students explore how migration, diaspora, colonialism, and globalization shape racial and ethnic identities across time and place. The major encourages students to develop critical and comparative perspectives on issues of social inequality, identity formation, and political belonging.
